name: theme_info
theme_name: I Win My Way — Athlete Engineering

settings.content: All applications post to Shopify's native contact form (emailed to your Notifications customer address — set that to info@iwinmyway.com) and, when the keys below are filled in, are also sent to Klaviyo as a profile + "Application Submitted" event carrying the program and tier.

settings.label: Klaviyo public API key (company ID)
settings.info: Found in Klaviyo > Settings > API Keys. This is the public key only — never paste a private key here.

settings.label: Klaviyo list ID for marketing consent
settings.info: Used only when a visitor checks the marketing-consent box on the Apply form.

settings.content: Install the Meta and Google & YouTube sales channel apps from the Shopify App Store for Pixel + Conversions API and GA4 + Google Ads — those handle checkout events natively. The fields below are only for extra, theme-level tags (e.g. Clarity, Hotjar via GTM) and are optional.

settings.label: Google Tag Manager container ID
settings.info: e.g. GTM-XXXXXXX — leave blank to skip.

settings.label: Meta Pixel ID
settings.info: Reference only — configure the actual Pixel + CAPI via the Meta channel app, not here.

settings.label: GA4 Measurement ID
settings.info: Reference only — configure via the Google & YouTube channel app, not here.

settings.label: Google Ads Conversion ID
settings.info: Reference only — configure via the Google & YouTube channel app, not here.

settings.label: TikTok Pixel ID (not in use)
settings.info: Left empty on purpose — client is not running TikTok ads yet. Fill in only when that changes.
